description: This file defines the HungarianMatcher class for computing assignment between predicted and target objects in an object detection model, including cost calculations and the matching algorithm.

classes.name: HungarianMatcher
classes.description: A PyTorch module that computes an optimal assignment between predicted and ground-truth objects based on a cost matrix involving classification, bounding box, and GIoU costs.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the HungarianMatcher with specified cost weights.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the matching between model outputs and targets, returning index pairs for matched predictions and targets.
